description: Cascade bitwise operations to build a complete structural index in a single pass using only bitwise primitives: XOR for string-state tracking, carry-less multiplication for prefix operations, AND/OR for structural character classification, and popcount + prefix-sum for position computation. Creates an 'index cascade' where each operation's output feeds the next, all operating on 64-bit bitmaps corresponding to 64 input bytes.
mathematical_formalization: For 64 input bytes, define bitmaps: Q = quote_bitmap, B = backslash_bitmap, S = structural_char_bitmap. Escaped quotes: E = B & (Q >> 1). String regions: R = prefix_xor(Q & ~E). Structural indices: I = S & ~R. Positions: P[i] = prefix_popcount(I). Total: ~12 instructions for 64 bytes = 0.1875 instructions/byte.
analogical_connections: Hardware adder carry chains: prefix-XOR for string state analogous to carry-lookahead
Mison structural indices: converting control flow to data flow
FPGA bitstream processing: combinational logic cascades for pattern matching
implementation_hypothesis: Implement using AVX-512: vpcmpeqb for detection, vpclmulqdq for prefix-xor, KAND for masking, popcnt for positions. All intermediates in registers. Process 64 bytes per iteration with no memory stores until final position array.
experiment_seed: Count instructions per byte via perf. Build standalone structural indexer. Profile with VTune for zero cache pollution. Target: <0.25 instructions/byte.
